title: Noietch/EVA-CLIENT
abstract:
EVA-Client: A Unified Framework for Deployment, Evaluation, and Data Collection on Real Robots

中文  ｜  English 📖 English Documentation  ｜  📖 中文文档  ｜  📄 Technical Report  ｜  🌐 Project Page > ⭐ If EVA-Client helps you, please click the "Star" button in the upper right corner. It keeps us going! ## 📝 Introduction EVA-Client is a unified framework for **deployment, evaluation, and data collection on real robots**. One policy, any robot: debug, record, evaluate, and visualize, all from a single browser console or headless from the command line. ## ✨ Key Features - **🚀 One-command Deployment**: A `.py` config brings up a real-robot closed loop: transport ([ROS 1](https://github.com/ros/ros) / [ROS 2](https://github.com/ros2/ros2) / [ZeroMQ](https://github.com/zeromq/pyzmq) / offline dataset) → policy backend → inference strategy (sync / [async](https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/kai0#train-deploy-alignment) / naive / [ACT-ensemble](https://github.com/tonyzhaozh/act) / RTC) with live latency compensation. - **🤖 Robot Zoo**: 8 robots supported out of the box, in joint space or EEF space (PyRoki IK), selected and brought up from the DEVICE tab. Fake mode lets you try everything without hardware. - **🧠 Multiple Policy Backends**: [OpenPI](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi), [OpenPI-RTC](https://www.pi.website/research/real_time_chunking), [StarVLA](https://github.com/starVLA/starVLA), [GR00T](https://github.com/Nvidia/Isaac-GR00T), [XPolicyLab](https://github.com/XPolicyLab/XPolicyLab), plus mock and replay backends for debugging. - **📊 Real-robot Evaluation**: Multi-checkpoint sweeps on task sets with milestones and per-attempt records. Every rollout captures camera video, a 3D URDF scene, per-dimension state charts, and milestone scores, then replays in sync in the RESULT tab. - **🎥 Data Collection**: Teleop (including WebXR VR controllers) straight into [LeRobot](https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot) episodes, with a background saver, camera health checks, in-tab QC replay, and export to LeRobot v3.0, MCAP, and HDF
abstract_zh: EVA-Client 是一个面向真实机器人的统一框架，集部署、评估与数据采集于一体。它支持从浏览器端到端驱动机器人，实现遥操作、记录、评估与可视化。该框架支持多种机器人硬件与数据格式，并提供基于 WebXR 的 VR 控制器遥操作、双 YAM 主从数据采集、导出至 LeRobot v3.0、MCAP 和 HDF5 等功能。此外，EVA-Client 还提供无头 CLI 与 ZMQ 控制通道，支持人在回路干预与实时价值曲线可视化，并探索了 MHS 风格的智能体到硬件接口。
tldr_zh: 统一框架实现真实机器人部署、评估与数据采集。
cover_zh: 一个策略驱动所有机器人？浏览器里搞定部署评估采集！
